definitions.explanation: A firmly established habit of doing something, almost always something undesirable or illegal. Most often appears in compounds about repeat offenders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遅刻|ちこく}→遅刻：03465_chikoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{常習|じょうしゅう}になっている。
examples.english: Being late has become a habit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{万引|まんび}き→万引き：16838_manbiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{常習|じょうしゅう}{犯|はん}だ。
⟦{無断|むだん}{欠勤|けっきん}→無断欠勤：17134_mudankekkin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{常習|じょうしゅう}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧し、ついに⟦{解雇|かいこ}→解雇：04561_kaiko⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: His unexcused absences became habitual, and he was finally fired.

notes:
{常習|じょうしゅう} refers to an ingrained habit of repeating an action — nearly always negative or criminal. It seldom appears alone, occurring mostly in compounds.

COMPOUNDS:
- {常習|じょうしゅう}{犯|はん}: habitual offender
- {常習|じょうしゅう}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become habitual
- {常習|じょうしゅう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: habitual; chronic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧: habit; custom — neutral, can be good or bad
- ⟦{癖|くせ}→癖：03814_kuse⟧: a personal quirk or habit
